Role Overview
We are looking for a hands-on Chartered Accountant to own core controllership execution end-to-end - statutory
audits, financial reporting and the upcoming transition to Ind AS, month-end close, investor and MIS reporting,
taxation and compliance, treasury, and internal financial controls. This is an execution-heavy individual-
contributor role for someone who takes full ownership of deliverables, keeps every number backed by
documented inputs, and anticipates audit and governance issues before they surface.
Must-Haves
  • Chartered Accountant with 5-6 years of post-qualification experience in controllership, audit or financial
    reporting.
  • Demonstrated experience handling statutory audits with Big 4 or comparable audit firms (either from within
    industry or from practice at a Big 4 / mid-tier firm).
  • Strong Ind AS proficiency, with practical application to standalone and consolidated financials; exposure to a first-time Ind AS transition rom Indian GAAP is a strong advantage.
  • Hands-on experience handling investor relations and MIS reporting
  • Experience managing direct and indirect tax risk (RPT, MAT, transfer pricing, GST) and coordinating filings and
    statutory / ROC compliance with external experts.
  • Strong command of Excel / Google Sheets and comfort building linked, self-updating trackers and models;
    exposure to Zoho Books ERP.
  • Sharp eye for detail with the discipline to keep every number backed by a documented input.

Good to Haves

  • Experience in a start-up, high-growth or restructuring environment where controllership is built and scaled
    rather than inherited
  • Exposure to IFC / IFCR implementation and to an RBI-regulated or otherwise regulated set-up.
  • Exposure to treasury / cash-flow management and to ROC / Companies Act and secretarial compliance.

Roles Responsibilities

1. Statutory Audit Assurance
- Independently handle statutory audits with Big 4 or comparable audit firms end-to-end - planning, preparing
schedules and reconciliations, resolving queries, and driving timely, clean closure with no major escalations.
- Serve as the primary finance point of contact for auditors; pre-empt audit and governance matters that have a
direct bearing on the financials and ensure the team is audit-ready at all times.
- Coordinate tax, GST and other statutory audits alongside the respective experts and consultants.

2. Financial Reporting Ind AS Transition
- Prepare standalone and consolidated financial statements, including multi-period and multi-entity
consolidations. The company currently reports under Indian GAAP (notified Accounting Standards).
- Lead the transition from Accounting Standards (Indian GAAP) to Ind AS - first-time adoption under Ind AS,
GAAP-to-Ind AS difference analysis, restatement of comparatives, and assessment of the impact on financials
and disclosures.
- Apply Ind AS to complex areas - revenue recognition, ESOP accounting, financial instruments, leases, expected
credit loss and related-party disclosures.
- Track changes in accounting standards and assess their impact on the companys financials.

3. Month-End Close Books
- Own a timely and accurate monthly close; support the transition of accounting in-house for real-time closure
after each month-end.
- Prepare and review key reconciliations, accruals and provisions; ensure every projection and output has a
documented, saved input with nothing left ad-hoc.

4. Investor Relations MIS Reporting
 - Handle investor reporting and MIS - prepare periodic investor decks, board and management MIS, and
performance dashboards accurately and on schedule.
- Respond to ad-hoc investor, board and regulatory (e.g. RBI / CoC) requirements - consolidated and standalone
financials, projections and write-ups - within tight turnaround times.

5. Taxation Statutory Compliance
- Manage direct and indirect tax risk end-to-end - related-party transaction (RPT) amendments, MAT exposure,
transfer-pricing documentation and GST structuring - owning the underlying analysis and outcomes while
working with external experts on execution.
- Oversee timely, accurate direct and indirect tax filings (income tax, TDS, GST) and coordinate tax and GST audits
and assessments.
- Coordinate statutory, ROC / Companies Act and secretarial compliances with the company secretary and
consultants; track related-party and regulatory documentation requirements.

6. Treasury Cash Flow
- Support treasury and cash-flow management - fund-flow planning, working-capital tracking and banking
relationships - and maintain accurate visibility of escrow and restricted balances.

7. Internal Controls, Policy Process
- Support the design, roll-out and testing of Internal Financial Controls (IFC / IFCR) and build a structured, audit-
ready control environment.
- Establish and maintain the accounting policy framework, SOPs and delegation-of-authority matrix; keep robust
documentation and process notes to strengthen governance and reduce audit and litigation risk.
- Drive ERP / accounting-system improvements and automation with appropriate system controls to enable
faster, more reliable reporting.

8. Planning Budgeting
- Maintain a working knowledge of the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) and budgeting cycle; partner with cross
functional teams on projections and budget-versus-actual variance analysis, with well-documented
assumptions.

You will be a key creative contributor to AHEAD s Design CoE - delivering high-impact presentation design, visual storytelling, and consulting communication outputs that directly influence pursuit outcomes and client engagement quality. This is a hands-on design role that combines deep craft excellence with an understanding of consulting context and business narrative. You will work at the intersection of data, design, and technology, collaborating closely with consultants, researchers, analysts, and technologists to create best-in-class presentation, visualization, and analytics solutions.

Design CoE Build-Out Team Leadership
  • Actively contribute to the smooth operation of the Design CoE - following intake workflows, briefing processes, quality review standards, and turnaround benchmarks; suggest improvements to processes as experience grows.
  • Collaborate closely with fellow Visual Communication Specialists and Presentation Analysts; model a design culture grounded in creative excellence, delivery discipline, and continuous improvement; support onboarding of junior team members when needed.
  • Participate in structured onboarding and training programs; take ownership of personal skill development across design craft, consulting communication, and emerging tools - and share learnings informally with peers.
  • Manage personal workload effectively across concurrent consulting engagements and research publications; flag capacity or prioritization conflicts proactively to the Team Lead.
  • Consistently meet quality and turnaround benchmarks; actively seek feedback from the Team Lead and stakeholders to raise the bar on every deliverable.
Narrative Excellence Strategic Design Partnership
  • Take primary ownership of complex, high-stakes design work - strategic proposals, executive communications, pursuit decks, and CxO/board-level presentations - delivering polished outputs with minimal iteration cycles.
  • Apply narrative excellence across consulting outputs: refining storylines, sharpening executive messaging, enhancing proposal storytelling, and translating insights into compelling slide sequences.
  • Transform unstructured inputs - scribbled notes, whiteboard captures, fragmented ideas, raw data, and oral briefs - into cohesive, structured, and visually compelling consulting narratives.
  • Collaborate with consulting and sales teams to develop differentiated win themes and visual pursuit strategies that strengthen proposal quality and CXO resonance.
  • Engage consulting stakeholders with recommendations on visual and narrative approach; build a reputation as a thoughtful creative collaborator who understands business context, not just design craft.
  • Translate analytical outputs into compelling visual stories and interactive experiences that make data and insight accessible and persuasive for client audiences.
  • Design interactive visualizations, exploratory data tools, and storytelling interfaces that elevate the quality and impact of AHEAD s consulting outputs.
Consulting Presentation Proposal Design
  • Execute end-to-end design of high-impact consulting presentations, executive proposals, and client-facing materials - from creative brief and storyboard through to polished, delivery-ready output.
  • Ensure all presentation materials comply with AHEAD s brand guidelines, maintain visual consistency, and project a consulting-grade professional standard across every client engagement.
  • Conduct self-review and peer review of design output before delivery; apply zero-defect, brand-compliant standards and incorporate creative feedback constructively to continuously improve output quality.
  • Handle the design intake and briefing process for assigned requests - ensuring accurate scope capture, clear expectation-setting on timelines, and proactive communication with requestors throughout delivery.
Visual Innovation Design IP Development
  • Actively contribute to the CoE s design IP initiatives - building reusable templates, visual frameworks, and self-service assets that scale design quality across AHEAD s consulting organization.
  • Contribute to and maintain AHEAD s visual asset library: standardized presentation templates, brand-compliant design systems, reusable frameworks, consulting-grade iconography, infographic libraries, and presentation accelerators.
  • Adopt and champion AI-powered design and productivity tools within your own workflow; contribute to building a high-velocity, human-in-the-loop design practice that delivers speed, quality, and brand governance.
  • Identify and implement design productivity improvements - automation shortcuts, reusable components, smarter iteration approaches - that meaningfully reduce rework and speed up content refinement cycles.
  • Stay current with best-in-class visual communication practices at leading consulting and advisory firms; bring forward relevant design innovations and ideas to strengthen AHEAD s creative edge.
Brand Stewardship Standards
  • Apply and uphold AHEAD s visual design language across all consulting outputs: presentation templates, color systems, typography standards, iconography libraries, chart styles, and data visualization frameworks.
  • Contribute to the maintenance and improvement of design standards, self-service playbooks, and consulting communication frameworks that enable consultants to produce brand-compliant, quality output independently.
  • Uphold consistency and quality of AHEAD s visual identity across all consulting, research, and thought leadership outputs - proposals, client presentations, research publications, CxO Guides, and webinar materials.
QUALIFICATIONS EXPERIENCE:
Essential
  • 6-9 years of progressive experience in presentation design, visual communication, or consulting design, with demonstrated ability to independently deliver high-quality design outputs in a consulting, advisory, or professional services environment.
  • Expert-level PowerPoint proficiency - master-slide management, bespoke layout design, complex data visualization, advanced charting, animation, and end-to-end deck construction from scratch to consulting-grade finish.
  • Strong working proficiency in design tools for infographics, custom visual frameworks, icons, and publication-quality design assets.
  • Demonstrated experience with AI-powered presentation, design automation, and productivity tools used in a professional services or consulting environment.
  • Proven ability to translate unstructured inputs - notes, whiteboards, raw data, oral briefs - into polished, executive-ready consulting narratives and presentation materials.
  • Familiarity with design standards, brand systems, and template libraries; ability to apply and maintain them consistently across a range of consulting output types.
  • A strong portfolio demonstrating consulting-grade presentation design - proposals, executive decks, research publications, and data-rich visual storytelling - produced to a high professional standard.
  • Creative excellence - sets a high aesthetic and storytelling bar for personal output; consistently delivers design work that elevates the quality of consulting materials and earns the trust of stakeholders.
  • Strategic communicator - understands the business context behind every brief and translates consulting intent into visual narratives that persuade, not merely present.
  • Builders mindset - comfortable working with ambiguity and incomplete briefs; brings a structured, solutions-oriented approach to every engagement and thrives in a fast-moving, high-expectation environment.
  • Innovation-oriented - actively explores new design tools, AI capabilities, and automation opportunities; eager to evolve personal workflows and contribute to the CoE s technological and creative edge.
Preferred
  • Bachelors or master s degree in engineering, Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Communication Design, or a related creative discipline.
  • Prior experience in a consulting firm in a Visual Graphics, Business Presentation Specialist, or senior design contributor role.
  • Experience building or managing AI-augmented design workflows, including prompt-based design generation, document-to-presentation conversion, or design automation pipelines.
  • Proficiency with consulting-grade data visualization and charting tools, and the ability to translate analytical outputs into polished, presentation-quality visual formats.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn t a buzzword - it s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and were looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforces core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era You re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Success Architect

Role Description

Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success.


Success Architects play a flexible and pivotal role in supporting a wide range of customers. They act as the customers first point of contact for a mix of reactive and proactive needs. This includes providing frontline technical support (Support), delivering educational Guide sessions to drive feature adoption, and assisting with foundational architectural health checks (basic Architect). They collaborate closely with senior Success Architects and Support Engineers to triage complex issues and ensure customers are on a path to long-term health, bridging the gap between daily challenges and long-term success.

Key Responsibilities
As a Sucess Architects specializing in Sales Cloud, you will:

  • Drive Customer Impact - Partner with a portfolio of customers, assessing their implementations and delivering recommendations on common technical issues, feature adoption (Guide), and foundational solution design (basic Architect).
  • Lead with Expertise - Serve as a trusted technical generalist, providing reactive and proactive guidance on product best practices.
  • Communicate with Clarity - Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to customer stakeholders and managers, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor.
  • Innovate & Solve Problems - Triage capability gaps and design inefficiencies, resolving common issues directly and escalating complex architectural challenges to senior Success Architects.
  • Execute Proven Strategies - Leverage and execute playbooks from Support, Guides, and the Architect team to meet customer needs
  • Build Strong Relationships - Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth.


Basic Requirements
Solution Design & Architecture

  • 3-5+ years of hands-on technical experience (e.g., Senior Support Engineer, Technical Consultant, or Senior Salesforce Admin).
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance and best practices.
  • Experience participating in complex implementations and understanding integration principles.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices.
  • Familiarity with industry- or vertical-specific solutions (preferred).

Communication & Leadership

  • Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and technical audiences.
  • Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage customer-facing discussions and explain technical concepts clearly.
  • High proficiency in English.

Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving

  • Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations and drive customer transformation.
  • Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
  • Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.
  • Desired Technical Skills

Sales Cloud Expertise

  • Strong functional and configuration knowledge of Sales Cloud features, including opportunity/pipeline management, forecasting, email integration and advanced capabilities such as Einstein Conversation Insights, Sales Engagement and Sales Performance Management.
  • Ability to configure and optimize these features to meet business needs.

Data Management & Integration

  • Proficient in understanding and troubleshooting data models, relationships (lookup/master-detail), validation rules and data governance best practices.
  • Experience with data import/export strategies, deduplication, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Informatica) and third-party connectors.

Secure & Scalable Architecture

  • Strong understanding of role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets and security configurations.
  • Ability to review a customers security model for common issues.
  • Skilled in identifying common anti-patterns and escalating to senior architects for resolution.

Salesforce Development

  • Ability to read, understand, and debug APEX, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
  • Hands-on development experience is a strong plus, but the primary focus is on configuration and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.

System Integration & Extensibility

  • Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects and tools like Salesforce Connect and Event Relay.

Certifications

  • Required: Salesforce Admin, Sales Cloud Consultant
  • Desired: Advanced Admin, Platform App Builder

Apply today to not only shape the future - but to redefine what s possible - for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Supply Chain Data Scientist
jobDescription:
Job Summary

The purpose of this role is practical application of data science in supply chain planning and inventory management to improve underlaying processes and deliver financial value.

To succeed in this role, you must have multidisciplinary skill set - proven experience in project management and SC planning, knowledge of planning systems (SAP APO/IBP, OM Partners or similar), SAP architecture (underlying tables, transactions) and strong technical and analytical skills.

In this creative role you will have unique opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders in the global organization working on various improvement initiatives, development of analytical tools, optimization models or supply chain simulations and you need to feel comfortable in each stage of this process (design, develop and deploy) to thrive and succeed.

You are self-starter with hands-on approach and continues improvement mindset working on your own initiative under moderate supervision. You know how to source and use data together with statistical methods and technology to improve processes. It is important you have theoretical knowledge but more important you understand how to use it in practice to add value.

Your nearest assignments will focus on portfolio segmentation, product life cycle management, development of replenishment strategies and inventory optimization within distribution network. All contributing to development of planning tool supporting decision making process for planning teams.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Supply Chain Management or APICS CPIM certification and 5-7+ years experience in Global Supply Chain and Inventory Management essential (multi-site, multi-region),
  • Degree or certification in Data Science desirable,
  • Formal Project Management and problem-solving training desirable, e.g., Six Sigma, Lean.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Demonstrated ability to select and work with appropriate analytical tools and software (Excel, PBI, relevant libraries in R and Python or SQL) and build ETL pipelines,
  • Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development and automation tools, such as Codex, to accelerate data analysis, code development, documentation, troubleshooting, and creation of analytical tools while applying appropriate validation and governance,
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, data quality, business relevance, bias, and operational feasibility before applying them to supply chain planning, inventory optimization, or decision-support processes,
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and visualize findings,
  • Demonstrated ability to wrangle, cleanse and model data from various sources (SAP, .csv, .xlsx, .txt, .parquet, .rds, data lake etc.),
  • Proficient in Excel and Power BI (Power Query/M, DAX, relational database model, data visualization); Power BI Data Analyst Associate certification is a plus,
  • Knowledge of SQL and R/Python highly desirable,
  • Experience working with data warehouse/data lake desirable (experience with Snowflake a plus),
  • Knowledge of Statistics and Machine Learning or strong willingness to quickly develop in this area.

Demonstrated ability to analyze large data sets and to prioritise actions for maximum impact.

Ability to develop and deploy short-term tools and reporting capabilities (with quantified accuracy and precision) essential.

Solid written and verbal communication skills, experience in a matrix environment desirable.

Environmental Working Conditions

Typically works in an office environment with adequate lighting and ventilation and a normal range of temperature and noise level.

Work assignments are diversified. Examples of past precedent are used to resolve work problems.

Most aspects of work are timebound and fit into a standard reporting cycle based on the monthly financial reporting calendar. There is an ongoing requirement to work to deadlines and to manage competing priorities.

Minimal physical effort is required. Work is mostly sedentary but does require walking, standing, bending, reaching, lifting or carrying objects that typically weigh less than 10 lbs.

jobDescription:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Product Delivery Manager – SaaS Implementation & Client Delivery Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Product Delivery Manager to lead the successful delivery of SaaS products and client implementations within the scholarly publishing sector. This role requires a strong combination of project management, business analysis, product delivery, and client engagement skills to ensure successful implementation and adoption of technology solutions.

The Product Delivery Manager will act as the key link between clients, Product teams, Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and internal stakeholders, ensuring that business requirements are accurately captured, translated into actionable product specifications, and delivered through structured implementation projects.

The ideal candidate should have experience managing end-to-end SaaS implementations, working with global clients (especially Europe and North America), and collaborating with cross-functional technology teams. Experience in an outsourcing environment and scholarly publishing/technology sectors will be highly preferred.

Key Responsibilities Client Delivery & SaaS Implementation
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of multiple SaaS implementation projects for new and existing clients.
  • Own the complete implementation lifecycle from discovery, requirements gathering, planning, development coordination, testing, go-live, and post-launch support.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the delivery journey.
  • Build strong relationships with global clients, including stakeholders across Europe and North America.
  • Develop and manage detailed project plans, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and resource requirements.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, QA, Customer Success, and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, budget, and according to agreed quality standards.
  • Conduct project meetings, sprint planning sessions, client workshops, and regular delivery reviews.
Requirements Gathering & Product Documentation
  • Work closely with clients to understand business processes, workflows, challenges, and functional requirements.
  • Lead discovery workshops and requirement-gathering discussions with business and technical stakeholders.
  • Translate client requirements into detailed product specifications and technical documentation.
  • Create and maintain:
    • Product Specification Documents (PSDs)
    • Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs)
    • User Stories
    • Acceptance Criteria
    • Workflow Diagrams
    • Process Documentation
  • Ensure clear communication of requirements between clients, Product Managers, Engineering, and QA teams.
  • Maintain requirement traceability throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Manage scope changes and change requests by evaluating impact on timelines, resources, and delivery commitments.
Product & Engineering Collaboration
  • Partner with Product Managers to align client requirements with product capabilities and roadmap priorities.
  • Collaborate closely with Engineering teams to clarify requirements and resolve implementation challenges.
  • Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, and Agile delivery activities.
  • Coordinate User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and ensure solutions meet defined acceptance criteria.
  • Support release planning, deployment activities, and post-release validation.
  • Work closely with technical teams on integrations, APIs, and system workflows.
Stakeholder & Client Management
  • Establish and maintain trusted relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Provide regular project updates, reports, risk assessments, and delivery dashboards.
  • Manage client expectations and proactively communicate project risks, dependencies, and mitigation plans.
  • Act as a bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Support client onboarding, training, adoption, and change management activities.
  • Handle escalations effectively and ensure timely resolution.
Delivery Excellence & Process Improvement
  • Improve SaaS implementation methodologies, project governance frameworks, and delivery processes.
  • Create reusable templates and documentation standards for:
    • Implementation plans
    • Product specifications
    • Project reporting
    • Client communication
  • Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency and enhance customer experience.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Product Delivery.
Required Skills & Experience Essential Requirements
  • 6–8+ years of experience in Product Delivery, SaaS Implementation, Technical Project Management, Product Operations, or Business Analysis roles.
  • Proven experience managing software/SaaS implementation projects from discovery to go-live.
  • Experience working directly with international clients, particularly Europe and North America-based customers.
  • Experience managing client-facing delivery engagements (not limited to internal coordination).
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, QA, and Customer Success.
  • Strong understanding of Agile delivery methodologies (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experience creating detailed product documentation, functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
Preferred / Desirable Experience
  • Experience working in an outsourcing/service delivery environment.
  • Experience delivering products in:
    • Scholarly publishing
    • Academic technology
    • SaaS platforms
    • Enterprise software solutions
    • Digital transformation projects
  • Experience managing integrations, APIs, and technical workflows.
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Familiarity with tools such as:
    • Jira
    • Azure DevOps
    • Monday.com
    • Confluence
    • Product management tools
  • Scrum Master, PMP, PRINCE2, AgilePM, or equivalent certification.
Key Competencies
  • Strong client-facing and consultative approach.
  • Ability to build relationships with senior stakeholders globally.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical requirements.
  • Highly organised with strong planning and prioritisation capabilities.
  • Comfortable managing ambiguity, changing requirements, and competing priorities.
  • Collaborative approach with the ability to influence Product and Engineering teams.
  • Commercial mindset with focus on customer value and successful delivery outcomes.

Preferred Candidate Profile:
A delivery-focused professional with experience managing global SaaS implementations, strong client engagement capabilities, excellent documentation skills, and the ability to bridge the gap between business requirements and technology execution. Experience in scholarly publishing, academic technology, or enterprise SaaS platforms will be an added advantage.

jobDescription:
DM-JD: Data Science & AI Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with a strong foundation in Data Science: predictive and forecasting who has built few Generative AI systems, with at least one production-grade GenAI deployment under their belt. The ideal candidate has spent the couple of years building forecasting models, time-series pipelines, and statistical/ML systems, and has since shipped and operated a real GenAI System in production not just a POC or hackathon build. You'll bring quantitative depth to areas like demand/price forecasting while owning GenAI architecture, observability, and agentic workflows.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Design and develop scalable GenAI applications, copilots, and chatbot systems
  • Build and optimize Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
  • Develop agentic workflows using LangGraph/LangChain
  • Apply forecasting and predictive modeling expertise to renewable energy use cases (e.g., generation forecasting, price/demand forecasting, asset performance prediction)
  • Design and build APIs and AI microservices using FastAPI or similar frameworks
  • Develop observability and monitoring pipelines using OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Grafana, or similar tools
  • Optimize AI systems for latency, scalability, reliability, and cost
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deploy production-grade AI and DS solutions

Technical Skills

Must Have:

  • At least 1-2 production-grade GenAI projects shipped and operated live — specifically a RAG-based chatbot, copilot, or assistant serving real users/traffic (not a prototype). Should be able to speak to real production concerns: latency, cost, scale, failure modes, monitoring, and iteration post-launch
  • Strong hands-on experience in predictive/forecasting data science — time-series modeling, regression, ensemble methods (e.g., LightGBM, XGBoost), or deep learning forecasting architectures
  • Solid grounding in statistical modeling, feature engineering, and model evaluation for forecasting problems
  • Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks
  • Strong understanding of RAG architecture — embeddings, chunking strategies, retrieval tuning, and vector search
  • Strong Python programming skills
  • Experience building REST APIs using FastAPI
  • Hands-on experience with vector databases/search platforms such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Milvus, or FAISS
  • Experience with observability tools like OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Langfuse, Grafana, or Azure Monitor
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP

Good to Have:

  • Prior experience in energy/utilities/manufacturing domains involving forecasting (demand, price, generation, or maintenance)
  • Experience with semantic caching, guardrails, or query rewriting in production RAG systems
  • Experience with multimodal AI systems
  • Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Knowledge of AI safety, guardrails, and prompt engineering

Eligibility Criteria

  • Strong system design and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to bridge classical ML/forecasting rigor with modern GenAI system design
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities
  • Should be able to walk through architecture and post-launch learnings of a shipped RAG/chatbot system in an interview

Who we are

Wayfair is moving the world so that anyone can live in a home they love. This journey is enabled by more than 3,000 Wayfair engineers and a data-centric culture.

The Customer Technology (CT) Science team builds and owns machine learning products that power search, marketing, and recommendations across Wayfair. Our algorithms address a broad range of challenges in the Wayfair marketplace, from helping suppliers add products to our catalog to enabling customers to discover and purchase a vast assortment of home goods and delivering marketing experiences customers love, all at web scale.

We are looking for an experienced Machine Learning Scientist to develop the next generation of personalization and customer understanding systems at Wayfair. You will build large-scale models that learn from billions of customer interactions to improve content recommendations, personalized search, and product discovery. You will also create reusable customer representations that support experiences across the Wayfair ecosystem.

In this role, you will own machine learning solutions end to end, from problem definition and hypothesis testing to model development, evaluation, and production deployment. You will partner closely with engineers, product managers, platform teams, and scientists to solve complex challenges in representation learning, ranking, retrieval, and personalization. Your work will translate advances in machine learning research into scalable capabilities used across search, recommendations, marketing, and other customer-facing products, improving relevance and discovery for millions of customers.


What youll do

  • Design, train, evaluate, and deploy large-scale machine learning models for customer understanding, personalization, search, and recommendations.
  • Evaluate and adapt advances in recommendation systems, representation learning, large language models, and foundation models to solve practical customer and business problems.
  • Develop rigorous offline evaluation frameworks and design online A/B tests to measure customer and business impact.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, and analytics teams to translate ambiguous customer needs into well-defined machine learning problems.
  • Partner with engineers to productionize models and build reliable, scalable training and inference pipelines.
  • Monitor model performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and continuously iterate on models in production.

What you’ll need

  • A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field with 6+ years of relevant industry experience; or a master’s degree in a related field with 4+ years of relevant industry experience.
  • Proven experience building and deploying machine learning models in production at scale.
  • Strong knowledge of machine learning, statistics, optimization, and modern deep learning techniques.
  • Experience designing, training, and evaluating models using large-scale datasets.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and experience partnering with engineering teams to build reliable, scalable ML systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to a range of audiences.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning.

Nice to have

  • Experience building recommender systems, personalization models, retrieval and ranking systems, or customer understanding models.
  • Experience with representation learning, embeddings, contrastive learning, sequence modeling, or transformer architectures.
  • Experience with distributed model training and large-scale retrieval and inference pipelines.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps and workflow orchestration tools such as Airflow, Kubeflow, MLflow, or Vertex AI.
  • Experience applying large language models or generative AI techniques to personalization, search, or recommendation problems.

- Flexible hybrid work environment offering 3 days work-from-office across key tech hubs (Indore, Pune, Bangalore).

- 5 to 10 years of experience in SDET, software engineering, or system test automation roles.
- Strong programming ability in Python and hands-on test framework experience using pytest.
- Solid understanding of macOS and Linux/Unix environments, file systems, TCP/IP, client-server architectures, and storage systems.
- Practical knowledge or exposure to NFS and SMB file protocols, permissions, authentication, and file locking.

Frontera is reimagining how children with autism and other behavioral health needs get the care they deserve. We bring together world-class clinicians, technologists, and autism specialists to build cutting-edge AI tools that help care teams work smarter and spend more time with the children and families who need them most.

Our platform is HIPAA-compliant and designed for the real-world needs of behavioral health teams - from psychologists to ABA therapists. By combining evidence-based care with powerful technology, we re expanding access to high-quality services for families everywhere.


 Our Mission

Frontera exists to close the care gap: every child, no matter where they live, should be able to access effective behavioral healthcare.

Role Overview

We are seeking a mission-driven Community Partner Development Lead to help grow our presence and expand access to pediatric behavioral health services across New Mexico. In this role, you will design and execute community and business development strategies that drive qualified referrals, primarily Frontera Diagnosis (FDx) evaluations and ABA services, by building relationships with the pediatricians, schools, clinics, and practices who serve families every day.

FronteraCare is our clinical services arm, the ABA and diagnostic (FDx) practices delivering direct care to families as part of Fronteras integrated care model. While this role sits within Fronteras centralized Growth team, it is fully dedicated to driving referral volume and market development for FronteraCare in New Mexico, working closely with FronteraCares clinical and operations teams to make sure outreach translates into care on the ground.

New Mexicos care landscape varies significantly by region, from the Albuquerque metro to rural counties and tribal communities. This role requires tailoring outreach and messaging to those different socioeconomic and cultural contexts, rather than applying a single statewide approach.

Youll bring creativity and resourcefulness to how you use technology, marketing channels, and professional networks to expand awareness of Fronteras services, and youll collaborate closely with internal teams to help shape a scalable growth strategy for the state.

This is a contract position.

What Youll Do

  • Develop and execute a creative market strategy to drive referral volume into both FDx evaluations and ABA services at our New Mexico clinics
  • Conduct ongoing market research and analysis to understand referral dynamics, community needs, and partnership opportunities in target regions
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders (pediatricians, clinics, early intervention programs, psychologists) and school-based sources (special ed directors, school psychologists, IEP teams, FIT program contacts
  • Lead new market launches in New Mexico by cultivating partnerships and building brand awareness in target regions
  • Partner cross-functionally with clinical, operations, marketing, and FDx/ABA intake teams to ensure referrals convert and local market insights inform company strategy
  • Track performance against both referral-volume and network-build metrics ( active partners onboarded, school/clinic coverage), and iterate strategy based on learnings
  • Leverage technology and marketing tools to broaden Fronteras reach and brand presence

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of combined experience in healthcare, behavioral health, community development, business development, partnerships, or outreach
  • A proven track record of driving growth through strategic relationships and partnerships
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills - youre energized by meeting people and building authentic relationships
  • Highly organized and self-motivated, with the ability to prioritize and execute in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment
  • Demonstrated cultural awareness and adaptability. Able to build trust and tailor approach across New Mexicos diverse communities, including rural and tribal populations, and adjust outreach style to differing socioeconomic realities and healthcare access barriers
  • Passionate about improving access to care for families and children
  • Track record of launching something new (a market, territory, program, or business) with minimal existing infrastructure or support
  • Comfortable operating without a fully-defined playbook, and willing to build the playbook as you go
  • Based in, or willing to be based in New Mexico

Preferred backgrounds:

  • Community development or partnerships experience in ABA, behavioral healthcare, or healthcare services
  • Existing ties to or lived experience in New Mexico, with working knowledge of the states healthcare/Medicaid landscape and provider network gaps
  • Experience with outreach in early intervention, special education, or pediatric programs
  • Familiarity with marketing tools or digital outreach strategies

$50 - $70 USD

  • Opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation in pediatric healthcare.

Join us in building the future of behavioral healthcare!
